caption: JUST IN: 🇧🇷🇺🇸Replica of the Statue of Liberty falls due to strong winds in Brazil.

A video circulating online shows a replica of the Statue of Liberty collapsing after being hit by strong winds in Brazil. The structure, commonly used as a decorative landmark outside a commercial property, appears to lose balance and fall to the ground during severe weather conditions.
Local reports say the area was experiencing heavy winds at the time of the incident. No injuries have been reported, and the damage appears to be limited to the statue itself.

Brazil is home to several replicas of the Statue of Liberty, often installed by businesses or shopping centers as visual attractions. The incident has sparked discussion online about safety standards and how such large decorative structures are secured during extreme weather.
